verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents an official quickstart for installing and initializing the gcloud CLI, with the exact install command shown. The pack has no quickstart that takes a developer from zero to a deployed, running service, and nothing shows the first deploy takes under an hour. missing for 10: an official zero-to-running-service deploy quickstart (e.g. Cloud Run) with exact deploy commands, evidence of time-to-first-deploy under an hour, hands-on or independent corroboration of the onboarding experience.

support.subject: As a developer, first deploy is under an hour — official quickstarts that go from zero to a running service with the exact commands shown

citations.quote: This quickstart describes the recommended method to install and initialize the Google Cloud CLI.
